name: Hearts
description: Classic 4-player trick-taking card game. Avoid taking tricks containing hearts (1 point each) or the Queen of Spades (13 points). Each hand, you pass 3 cards to a neighbour (direction rotates: left → right → across → keep). The 2 of clubs leads the first trick; you must follow suit if possible. Shoot the Moon — take all 26 penalty points in one hand — to flip the scoring on your opponents. First player to hit the target score ends the match; the player with the LOWEST total wins.

phases.name: playing
phases.description: Single phase. Hearts module cycles passing → trick play → scoring internally.

entity_types.name: Player
entity_types.description: A Hearts player. Holds a hand of cards and a running penalty-point total.

properties.name: hand
properties.description: Cards currently in hand (hidden from opponents).

actions.name: pass_cards
actions.description: PASS STAGE — pass 3 cards in the direction shown in your perception. REQUIRED `cards`: list of 3 exact card strings from your hand (e.g. ["Q♠", "K♥", "2♣"]). The 3 highest-rank cards in your worst suit are a safe default; if you're shooting the moon, hold your high cards.

parameters.name: cards
parameters.description: 3 cards from your hand to pass.

actions.name: play_card
actions.description: PLAY STAGE — play exactly one card from your hand on your turn. REQUIRED `card`: the EXACT card string. RULES: must follow led suit if possible; on the first trick, no hearts or Q♠ may be played; hearts can't be LED until broken. EXAMPLE: play_card(card="7♦").

actions.name: discuss
actions.description: Open table-talk. Comment on the play, signal your hand strength (or sandbag), needle opponents.

personas.persona_text: Disciplined Hearts veteran. Plays tight: ducks Q♠, off-loads high spades early, and only shoots the moon when it's almost certain.
goals: Detect when an opponent might be shooting the moon.

personas.persona_text: Aggressive moon-shooter. Hoards high cards on the pass, ducks low to bait opponents, swings for 26 points whenever the math is borderline.
goals: Land at least one moon shot.

personas.persona_text: Watchful tactician. Reads passes and discard patterns to figure out who has Q♠. Adjusts mid-hand based on signals.
goals: Steer the trick winner toward the heaviest opponent.

personas.persona_text: Wildcard. Mixes safe play with the occasional speculative high-card lead just to see what surfaces. Hates being predictable.
goals: Slip Q♠ to the leader when possible.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.hearts.target_score
runtime_parameters.label: Target Score
runtime_parameters.description: Match ends when any player reaches this many penalty points. Lower = shorter matches.

termination_conditions.name: match_over
termination_conditions.description: A player crossed the target score.
